rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "Halcyon Threshold — weekly Monday check-in" (0 8 * * 1) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: Weekly Monday 8am scheduled session created: triages inbox, advances the project, updates the decisions memo, messages you. It's hard-limited from sending, paying, posting, publishing, or submitting forms. Delete it if you'd rather not.
